name: Salvatore De Meo - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on product safety and regulatory compliance in e-commerce and non-EU imports
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for tougher action on cheap goods bought from online sellers outside the EU, especially China. It wants the EU rule that lets parcels worth under 150 euros in without customs duty removed. It wants more money and staff for customs and product safety inspectors, better tracking of products sold online, and clearer responsibility for platforms when unsafe goods reach buyers. This is a set of recommendations; it does not itself change the law.

- **What changes:** nothing yet; Parliament asks for an end to the 150 euro customs duty exemption and more checks.
- **Who it affects:** shoppers, EU shops and makers, customs and safety inspectors, and non-EU online platforms.
- **What happens next:** the European Commission and member states must act on the requests, including talks on customs reform.
